prompt:
You run weekly onboarding A/B tests. Here is every finished test so far: what you predicted
and what was measured.

- round 1: Move Sign-In After Pet Adoption [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +12.0%, measured +16.8% (p=0.0), won
- round 1: Interactive Desktop Control Guide on Finish [finish, new_flow]: predicted +10.0%, measured -6.6% (p=0.207102), lost: no clear effect
- round 1: Instant Ready-to-Adopt Pet Choice Grid [adoption, layout]: predicted +15.0%, measured +2.4% (p=0.561281), lost: no clear effect
- round 1: Time Estimate & Error Safeguard on Waiting Screen [home, wait_info]: predicted +8.0%, measured -3.5% (p=0.257077), lost: no clear effect
- round 1: Clear Path Selection Copy [choose_path, copy]: predicted +8.0%, measured +0.6% (p=0.771416), lost: no clear effect
- round 2: Account Sync Safeguard Warning [sign_in, hint]: predicted +3.0%, measured +4.2% (p=0.052352), lost: no clear effect
- round 2: Desktop Tray Status Notification Prompt [finish, notification]: predicted +2.0%, measured -5.4% (p=0.320894), lost: no clear effect

- round 3: Photo Upload Step Card Layout Redesign [adoption, redesign]: predicted +3.0%, measured -2.5% (p=0.522638), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Account Recovery & Sync Helper Hint [sign_in, hint]: predicted +4.0%, measured -3.2% (p=0.083096), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Interactive Mascot Progress Updates [home, wait_info]: predicted +9.0%, measured +3.8% (p=0.138637), lost: no clear effect

- round 4: First Desktop Companion Welcome Incentive [finish, incentive]: predicted -2.5%, measured -6.4% (p=0.165811), lost: no clear effect

Previous lessons:
Reordering onboarding steps (moving sign-in after adoption) was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
Live progress visualizers on the waiting screen were helpful and far exceeded predictions (+9.3% measured vs +2.0% predicted), whereas static time estimates, safeguards, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Finish screen additions (control guides, notification prompts, owner badges) showed no clear effect, and predictions were set too high.
Adoption step layout changes and redesigns showed no clear effect, with predictions (up to +15.0%) being overly optimistic.
Path selection copy and layout adjustments showed no clear effect, over-predicting impact.
Sign-in hints and safeguard warnings showed no clear effect, with predictions set too high.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Moving sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted), whereas moving sign-in before final launch showed no clear effect.

Live progress visualizers on the waiting screen were helpful and far exceeded predictions (+9.3% measured vs +2.0% predicted), while static time estimates, safeguards, checklists, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Adoption step redesigns significantly hurt performance (-27.5% measured), while adoption layout changes showed no clear effect and had overly optimistic predictions.
Finish screen additions (control guides, notification prompts, badges, and incentives) showed no clear effect, and positive predictions were set too high.
Path selection copy and layout adjustments showed no clear effect, with predictions over-estimating impact.
Sign-in helper hints and safeguard warnings showed no clear effect, with predictions set too high.
